title: UP Anganwadi Bharti Online Form 2026 (Updated)
organization: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
postName: Anganwadi Worker / Helper / Mini Anganwadi posts (district-wise)
vacancyDetails: District-wise Anganwadi Worker, Sahayika/Helper and related posts under UP ICDS / WCD (updated notifications)
qualification: As per post – generally Intermediate / High School with local residence criteria as per district notification
ageLimit: As per UP Anganwadi / WCD district recruitment rules
applicationFee: As per district online portal (often nil or nominal)
selectionProcess: Merit based on educational marks / local criteria → Document Verification → Appointment
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit official UP WCD / district Anganwadi recruitment portal or UP Online related link
2. Select district and post (Worker/Helper)
3. Register and fill form with local documents
4. Upload certificates and submit
5. Track merit list on district portal
shortDescription: UP Anganwadi Bharti Online Form 2026 updated – district-wise Worker/Helper vacancies. Apply on official WCD/district portals.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Women & Child Development / district authorities release updated Anganwadi Bharti notifications for Workers and Helpers.

Applications are typically district-wise on official portals. Candidates must meet residence and educational criteria of the concerned Anganwadi centre area.

Keep checking district WCD notices for latest start/last dates and merit lists.
